notes.title: UnMetal demo
notes.notes:
Dear player,

I've been working hard on a new project called UnMetal. It's a parody of the mytic Metal Gear saga with a lot of humor and action/stealth gameplay:

[previewyoutube=OiWDJn6200w;full][/previewyoutube]

Please enter UnMetal Steam's page, have a look at the trailer. If you like it, please play the demo and include it in your wishlist. I'm sure you will enjoy it.

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1203710/UnMetal]UnMetal page on Steam[/url]


Including UnMetal in your Wishlist will help the game to be more featured and, therefore, have more visibility, especially in the Steam Game Festival that is taking place these days.

Thank you!
fran

notes.title: new game: MiniGhost!
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/24590547/21cd09007c901ba7406e57b345a08b3b71f32e9f.jpg[/img]

My dear players, I have just published a new game named [b]"Mini Ghost"[/b]
It's a prequel to Ghost 1.0: Ghost's first mission!

"Mini Ghost" is a mini metroidvania in the 80's MSX art style and gameplay.
Includes editors to create and share in Workshop your own maps+tilesets and even your own characters... and it also includes a special section to watch and troll your friends while they play!

Have a look here:
https://youtu.be/pVNCVb1Brrs

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/24590547/1218f702a5c770dc46f98a5568888cbc654e0ae5.jpg[/img]

https://youtu.be/c6VpDzwJjow

I hope you have mini fun with this new mini big adventure!

fran

notes.title: V 1.1: Missions Mode
notes.notes:
Hello dear players!

[h1]MISSION MODE[/h1]

Version 1.1 is Live! Includes the "Mission Mode", a new extra content that includes 12 independent short missions to be done in around 5 to 15 minutes.

Each mission has 3 achievements. One to complete the mission and two more to be achieved by doing something special in that particular mission.

By default missions will be locked. This is done in order to prevent spoils. As you progress in the main campaign, your'll find icons of missions that will unlock them.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/24590547/e40a3f560d0f69d104b700388f8dc8df67d22445.png[/img]

If you already finished the game, then all missions will be available by default (obviously there is nothing to spoil if you already finished it).

Last, but not least, if you already started a game and don't want to search icons, feel free to use this map to locate them:

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/24590547/3437599cf0be629780aa2c30a295933374b13c2b.jpg[/img]

This new content is free and is included in the game. No DLC is needed.

[h1]MISSION SKIN[/h1]

In case you like the new extra content and you want to help a bit, there is a DLC called "Ghost 1.0 - Mission Skin" you can purchase.
It totally optional, and as thanks, you'll gain access to a new skin for Ghost (visual change, no special abilities).

[url]http://store.steampowered.com/app/614080/[/url]

This new Skin will appear directly in the "mission mode" and, if you complete all 12 missions (secondary achievements not needed), then this skin will also be available in the main campaign, so you can select it in 3D printers.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/24590547/250e3d076340bffac797776c1c56c9066e9d5107.png[/img]

notes.title: Coming soon: "Missions mode"
notes.notes:
Hello dear players,

Next 24th of March (in two weeks time) I will release new extra content for Ghost 1.0: the[b] "Missions Mode"[/b].

This will be a set of 12 short missions that can be done in 5-15 minutes.
Each mission has it's goal and some of them have special rules. It's some sort of "minigames".

Besides, each mission will include 3 Steam achievements: one for completing it and two additional ones by doing something specific in the mission. All will be different.

Achievements are already uploaded to Steam, so you can now have a look to how they will be.

To prevent spoiling scenarios and enemies that appear later in the main game, missions will be unlocked by collecting their icons.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/24590547/e40a3f560d0f69d104b700388f8dc8df67d22445.png[/img]

Their icons will not be hidden. On the contrary, they will be visible so you can get them all easily.
For those who already finished the game, all missions will be automatically unlocked (as there is nothing to spoil).

Instead of doing a DLC with the missions mode and force players to pay for it, I will include them directly in the game. To get some money to pay this new content I will probably publish a simple DLC with a skin for the missions mode that players may buy just to "support the developer".

Thanks for reading!

notes.title: AFK + current status
notes.notes:
Hello dear players!

It's been already more than a month since Ghost 1.0 was released. In these days I uploaded 28 version including strange bugs fixed and changes asked by the community. Besides, I've been paying attention to each thread I saw in this forum, and answering the ones that were not answered by Jacklifear or someone else.

You can see/follow all changes done in this thread:
[url]http://steamcommunity.com/app/463270/discussions/0/357288572114954779/[/url]

For personal reasons I'm afraid it will be hard for me to access this forum in the next weeks. That means that it could take some time until I answer threads. But other people, like Jacklifear (the community manager) and other players will help answering questions.

That's all for now!
fran
